name: Major Town Houses of the Architect Victor Horta (Brussels)
description: In Brussels, four townhouses by architect Victor Horta (Hôtel Tassel, Hôtel Solvay, Hôtel van Eetvelde and his own home and studio) helped launch Art Nouveau in the 1890s. Inside, you'll find airy open layouts, rooms filled with natural light, and sweeping whiplash curves in ironwork, mosaics and painted walls that flow into the structure itself. They look like ordinary city homes from the street.
